description: Kemet Nova is a multidisciplinary Egyptian team for NASA Space Apps 2025, tackling “Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data.” We’re building a decision-support tool that helps farmers adapt to climate shifts, plan resilient crop rotations, and protect soil health using NASA Earth observation data. Our team combines engineering, full-stack development, AI/ML, chemistry, pharmacy, and design to turn satellite data into practical solutions for food security and sustainable agriculture.
